name: Skill install
responsibility: Installs through the CLI, then swaps in the arm's package, the frozen baseline or the candidate copy the batch kept, and re-derives its generated files
description: TASK-471.03. install-skill runs with --repo alone and writes no setup block. The run's vault is the .archboard/vault that the run's checkout already holds (the run's configuration is written there before the install), so a command run in the checkout finds it without a setting. The install record holds the digest of the installed skill and no block.
